status: DEMO POLICY — illustrative, not an agreed policy

policy_certification.note: Periodic sign-off of this policy itself (SEC 15c3-5-style). Not done for the demo.

rules.why: A PR must not change the rules, analyzers or CI that judge it.
rules.motivated_by: Red-team review (wave 2): agent edits the rules that judge it; triage always uses base-revision policy.

rules.why: Changes to what an analyzer or generator reports change what every user of the library is warned about.
rules.motivated_by: MessagePack #2283: a silently missing resolver shipped across two releases. MiFID II RTS 6 Art. 11(1): depth of review proportionate to the change.

rules.why: A change to a field or helper used at many call sites alters behavior far beyond the edited lines.
rules.motivated_by: Spotify (Oct 2026): change volume outpaced verification controls. Rewind (2026): risk has almost nothing to do with line count.

rules.why: Public API changes are contracts for downstream users.
rules.motivated_by: Common practice (Cloudflare, Adyen): contract changes always reviewed in depth.

rules.why: Very large PRs exceed effective human review; split or review in depth.
rules.motivated_by: Vercel (largest monorepo): 100+ changed files always HIGH. SmartBear/Cisco: effectiveness drops above ~400 LOC.

rules.why: Documentation that states behavior must match a decision the reviewer accepts.
rules.motivated_by: Gong et al. (MSR 2026): descriptions claiming unimplemented changes are the most common mismatch type in agent PRs.

rules.why: Tests written by the authoring agent cannot certify its own work; they must be shown able to fail.
rules.motivated_by: Optiver (2026): agents claim success when they haven't — self-certification removed.

rules.why: A changed expected value in an existing test can pin wrong behavior.
rules.motivated_by: Red-team review (wave 2): tests that pin wrong behavior.

protected_paths.why: Always a human, whatever the AI says (Rewind protected paths; Cloudflare auth/crypto always full review).

light_requires: whitespace-only or docs-only outside shipped code, and no other rule fires

signoff.separation_of_duties: signer must not be the PR author (the agent's operator)
